sender.en: A social media ad or video, sometimes a deepfake of a UAE minister or well-known figure

name.en: Deepfake investment ad: “invest in this programme with guaranteed returns”

how.en: Ads and videos on social media promote trading in shares, gold, oil or crypto with quick, guaranteed returns, sometimes using AI deepfakes of senior UAE officials. In October 2025 the UAE Minister of Economy said videos of him recommending shares were deepfakes. Victims are sent to fake websites, asked to register and to transfer money urgently. Dubai Police and the Ministry of Interior say legitimate platforms never guarantee profits or push urgent transfers.
